notes.title: Patch release
notes.notes:
A new update is released for Fabric. Change notes is briefly as follows:

- Fixed an issue where gravity direction is not properly cleared upon returning to main menu.
- Fixed an issue where bending action behaves erratically wrong in a specific bend configuration in level 20.
-Fixed an issue with controller sensitivity.
- Minor tweaks to first few levels.

If anything isn't working for you, please let us know.

notes.title: IndieCade Europe 2016 Selection
notes.notes:
[url=http://europe.indiecade.com/?lang=en][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25876102/4ab875302837961bbcfea3a510997f24caecdf5b.png[/img][/url]
Hey everyone!

We are proud to announce our selection for IndieCade Europe 2016. Fabric is officially nominated as one of the best indie games of the year for IndieCade Europe Festival.

The first edition of the event will take place in Paris on November 18-19. We are excited to attend this awesome event! 

You guys can check out all the selected titles [url=http://europe.indiecade.com/?page_id=42&lang=en]here[/url]

Hope to see you there

Torreng Labs
